reason: The README describes a DSH plugin that lets the model schedule session-context compaction after the current turn and records the result in the session log, making memory-context its primary purpose.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注册 compact_now 工具，让模型可在回合结束后安排会话上下文压缩并记录结果。
summaries.en: Registers a compact_now tool for DeepSeek Harness so the model can schedule session-context compaction after the current turn and record the result.

capabilities: Schedules session-context compaction after the agent becomes idle
Records compaction results in the session log
